Class EnhancedVector

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Integer>
java.util.AbstractList<Integer>
java.util.ArrayList<Integer>
solvers.dataStructures.EnhancedVector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnhancedVector>, Iterable<Integer>, Collection<Integer>, List<Integer>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<Integer>
Direct Known Subclasses:
MultiplicitiesVector, PopulationChangeVector, PopulationVector
public class EnhancedVector extends ArrayList<Integer> implements Comparable<EnhancedVector>
This class extends the ArrayList<Integer> object class by adding several useful methods for operations encountered when dealing with the algorithms that compute the normalising constants.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010,, amended by Jack Bradshaw 2012. Amendments: No longer implements comparable, to allow subclasses to do so

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(EnhancedVector o)
      Compares two EnhancedVector objects according to the sum of their elements. elements. If they have the same sum, then the one with the leftmost non-zero is the smaller.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<EnhancedVector>
      Parameters:
      o - The other EnhancedVector object
      Returns:
      -1 if this < o, 0 if this = o, 1 if this > o
